g.text: C23 native node binding and caller authority
allocation/incarnation plus slot; no NodeId-to-address arithmetic
actual source order; incomplete publication is not complete binding
owner ready, live spans, injective mapping and field containment
payload leases settled; old target read authority closes
node storage incarnation unchanged; union role changes
retain cache and return-domain duty; consumer progress is not source completion
existing leases drain; native cleanup has independent receipt
same address can be reused; old query key rejected
record service can answer without touching old/new native cache
